name: Church Of Israel
overview: The Church of Israel is established by God's covenant, marked visibly by the ordinance of circumcision as a perpetual sign of belonging to His people, including both natural-born Israelites and proselytes (Genesis 17:10-13). Those who fail to observe this covenant are excluded, illustrating the seriousness of membership and the spiritual purity required within the congregation (Genesis 17:14; Numbers 5:2). This assembly is not only a physical community but also a spiritual church with appointed worship, ministry, feasts, and ordinances, reflecting a type of the church of Christ and emphasizing the privileges and responsibilities of those in covenant with God.
